scope_rule: A reconciled first-v1 timestamp before the requested window, with both first submission and latest observed update at or before the previous review cutoff and no observed current-window announcement, separate source signal, or unresolved identity/time, closes the current window date gate only. The disposition refers to when v1 first appeared; the latest observed revision may be newer than v1.
limitation: No substantive paper decisions or source-exhaustiveness claim; absence of a signal is bounded to the pinned captures. Do not enter terminal_ids into the substantive discovery ledger.
